decisions.reason: Particle therapy water phantoms serve a growing niche of proton centres with long procurement cycles, so a few years after release the product is still within its expected ramp-up and fits the firm's strategic positioning in scanning QA.

After Product B was withdrawn, Product C is the remaining small-volume chamber, which removes the internal overlap and lets it fill the small-field dosimetry need without a clear shortfall against aspirations.
The standard clinical chamber line is a core, calibration-linked staple of absolute dosimetry that very likely meets aspirations and anchors the established business.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and QA platform, so they generate pull-through sales and show no evident shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
Thimble chambers are long-lived standard products with steady demand and low carrying cost, so keeping them is consistent with satisficing behaviour.
